parameters.jsCode: for(const key of ['store_domain','actor_id','correlation_id','agent_key','purpose']){if(!$json[key])throw new Error(`${key} is required`);}return [{json:{...$json,session_id:String($json.session_id || ''),resource_type:String($json.resource_type || ''),resource_id:String($json.resource_id || ''),query:String($json.query || '').slice(0,2000),max_items:Math.max(1,Math.min(50,Number($json.max_items || 20))),allowed_sensitivity:Array.isArray($json.allowed_sensitivity)?$json.allowed_sensitivity:['PUBLIC','INTERNAL'],requested_scopes:Array.isArray($json.requested_scopes)?$json.requested_scopes:[]}}];

parameters.query:
WITH selected_store AS (
  SELECT id FROM automation_os.stores WHERE shop_domain = $1 AND active = true
), current_conversation AS (
  SELECT c.id FROM automation_os.conversations c JOIN selected_store s ON s.id=c.store_id WHERE c.external_session_id=$2 LIMIT 1
), recent_messages AS (
  SELECT 'conversation'::text AS source_type, m.id::text AS source_id, m.created_at AS observed_at, 1.0::numeric AS confidence, jsonb_build_object('role',m.role,'content',m.content,'agent',m.selected_agent_key) AS content
  FROM automation_os.conversation_messages m JOIN current_conversation c ON c.id=m.conversation_id
  ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 12
), scoped_memory AS (
  SELECT 'memory'::text AS source_type, mi.id::text AS source_id, mi.source_observed_at AS observed_at, mi.confidence, jsonb_build_object('kind',mi.kind,'resource_type',mi.resource_type,'resource_id',mi.resource_id,'memory_key',mi.memory_key,'status',mi.status,'content',mi.content,'source_type',mi.source_type,'source_id',mi.source_id,'expires_at',mi.expires_at) AS content
  FROM automation_os.memory_items mi JOIN selected_store s ON s.id=mi.store_id
  WHERE mi.status='VERIFIED'
    AND (mi.expires_at IS NULL OR mi.expires_at > now())
    AND mi.sensitivity = ANY($6::text[])
    AND ($3='' OR mi.resource_type=$3)
    AND ($4='' OR mi.resource_id=$4)
    AND ($5='' OR mi.content::text ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%' OR mi.memory_key ILIKE '%' || $5 || '%')
  ORDER BY mi.confidence DESC, mi.source_observed_at DESC LIMIT $7
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM recent_messages UNION ALL SELECT * FROM scoped_memory) context ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT $7;

parameters.jsCode: const request=$('Validate Memory Request').first().json;const records=$input.all().map(item=>item.json).filter(row=>row.source_type && row.source_id);const context=records.map(row=>({source_type:row.source_type,source_id:row.source_id,observed_at:row.observed_at,confidence:Number(row.confidence),content:row.content}));return [{json:{status:'MEMORY_RETRIEVED',correlation_id:request.correlation_id,agent_key:request.agent_key,purpose:request.purpose,store_domain:request.store_domain,context,count:context.length,authoritative_current_data_required:true,notice:'Memory supplements but never overrides current authoritative Shopify, CJ, policy, or approval data.'}}];
